items.title: File Widerspruch against Kinderzuschlag decision
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar.
items.computation: Bescheid is dated 20.11.2026 (Friday). The letter states its own delivery-fiction rule: the Bescheid is deemed bekannt gegeben am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post. Assuming posting on the Bescheid date (20.11.2026), the 4th day after is 24.11.2026 (Tuesday), a normal business day, so no shift is needed; this is the date of Bekanntgabe. Under SGB X / Section 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period triggered by this event ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of the event, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a statutory public holiday in NRW, so the deadline stands.

warnings: The letter contains placeholder/sample data (sender 'Familienkasse Musterlahn', address 'Beispielwetzlar', marked 'Musterausgabe'), suggesting this may be a template/test document rather than a genuine official notice; verify authenticity before relying on it.

The stated 4-day postal delivery fiction is longer than the usual 3-day fiction under SGB X Section 37 Abs. 2; the exact date of posting (Aufgabe zur Post) was assumed equal to the Bescheiddatum (20.11.2026) since it is not separately stated, so if actual posting was later the Widerspruch deadline would shift accordingly.
